title: Signal: Reflective invocation via Activator.CreateInstance (csharp) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on the Activator.CreateInstance call in csharp code.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: any Activator.CreateInstance call matches whether or not the name is user-controlled. Regex cannot prove data flow; a constant name is a false positive.
fpNotes: Constant names and framework-internal reflection are the common false positives.
